UI_GQOS_sortDoubleClickDelay_tooltip: Time window used to recognize a double press for sorting option 5. Default: 200 ms. Smaller values require a faster double press.
UI_GQOS_combinedContainerSwitch_tooltip: With the in-game LB/RB container switching option set to mode 3, a short tap on LB advances the carried-container selection and a short tap on RB advances the searched-container selection. Holding LB/RB with Up/Down keeps the existing mode 3 behavior.
UI_GQOS_gamepadDragTransfer: Gamepad item selection and drag transfer
UI_GQOS_multiSelectDragHoldDelay_tooltip: While items are multi-selected, hold B this long to start dragging. A shorter B tap performs the normal B action on release. Default: 200 ms.
UI_GQOS_xContainerTransferEnabled_toolti:
Tap X and release: transfer the selected items to the other pane's current container.
Hold X: pick a destination container with the D-pad, then release X to transfer.
UI_GQOS_xContainerHoldDelay_tooltip: Time before X enters destination-container selection mode. Default: 200 ms. Use a shorter delay for faster selection, or a longer delay to reduce accidental long presses.
UI_GQOS_MS_Enabled_tooltip: Enable multi-selection in the inventory and searched-container lists.
UI_GQOS_MS_Button_tooltip: Toggle the focused row and set the range-selection start point. Default: R3.
UI_GQOS_MS_SelectAll_tooltip:
Default: press L3 + R3 together.
If this mod has already selected something, this clears the whole selection.
Only a list with nothing selected performs the select-all.
UI_GQOS_MS_RangeSelect_tooltip: After setting a start row with the single-item selection button, move focus to the end row and press this button. Default: L3.
UI_GQOS_yShortcutEnabled_tooltip:
Hold Y and press a direction to run its assigned action.
Keep Y held and press another direction to switch to another panel.
After a combo, releasing Y will not also run the normal Y action.
Y + left-stick panel selection is controlled by the separate switch below.
UI_GQOS_yShortcutMapping_tooltip: Choose what a D-pad direction does while Y is held. Defaults: Up=Health, Down=Backpack, Left=Building, Right=Crafting. Building/Crafting use native Select-wheel commands; Health, Backpack, and Fitness explicitly receive gamepad focus.
UI_GQOS_panelQuickSelectEnabled_tooltip:
While standing still, hold Y to block player movement; push the left stick to immediately switch gamepad focus to a visible window in that direction, using the game's native green focus border.
Release Y to keep the selected focus. If the stick is not moved, releasing Y performs the normal Y action. If the stick is already moving when Y is pressed, panel selection will not start.
When disabled, Y + left stick will not select a window and will not cancel the normal Y action; Y + D-pad shortcuts are unaffected.
UI_GQOS_yEnhancementEnabled_tooltip:
Master switch for both features below.
Enabled: this mod handles Y while it is held, enabling Y + D-pad shortcuts and Y + left-stick panel selection.
Disabled: no interception or delay at all; Y goes straight to the game's native handler on press, so the original action fires immediately.
UI_GQOS_multiSelectDragEnabled_tooltip: Disabled by default. When enabled, after multi-selecting items hold B until the threshold, then move the LEFT stick to move the virtual drag cursor. Release B over another container button or inventory list to transfer. A short B tap still performs the normal B action (such as expand/collapse).
UI_GQOS_RBMoodle_Hint: RB + Up/Down to browse · hides automatically
UI_GQOS_rbExtensionsEnabled_tooltip:
Works only with closed container windows and world focus.
When disabled, RB combos use native behavior; when a container window is open, existing container switching remains active.
UI_GQOS_rbDpadAction_tooltip: Choices are restricted by direction: RB + Up/Down can be Disabled, Previous Moodle, or Next Moodle; RB + Left/Right can be Disabled, Zoom In, or Zoom Out. When an inventory or loot window is open, RB + Up/Down remains handled by the existing container-switching logic.
UI_GQOS_rbButtonAction_tooltip: Choose the zoom action for RB followed by Y or A. By default RB+Y zooms in and RB+A zooms out. Works only with world focus and closed container windows.
UI_GQOS_RTBFocusTitle: RT + B Focus Return / Close Panels
UI_GQOS_RTBFocusEnabled: Enable RT + B focus return and close panels
UI_GQOS_RTBFocusEnabled_tooltip:
Hold RT and tap B.
Focus on a panel: return gamepad focus to the player, panels stay open.
Keep RT held and tap B again: close all visible detectable panels. Persistent HUD elements stay open.
UI_GQOS_RightRadialSmashWindowEnabled: Add Smash Window to the D-pad wheel
UI_GQOS_RightRadialSmashWindowEnabled_to:
While the D-pad wheel is open, adds "Smash Window" when an intact window is nearby.
The facing square is checked first, then the surrounding ring.
UI_GQOS_RightRadialLightSwitchEnabled: Add Light Switch to the D-pad wheel
UI_GQOS_RightRadialLightSwitchEnabled_to:
While the D-pad wheel is open, adds "Turn Light On / Off" when a usable light switch is nearby.
Switches without power are not offered.
UI_GQOS_RightRadialFitnessEnabled: Add Fitness Panel to the right D-pad wheel
UI_GQOS_RightRadialFitnessEnabled_toolti: When enabled, adds a quick-open Fitness Panel option alongside the existing Map, Help, Designated Livestock Area, and other actions. When disabled, the vanilla wheel is left unchanged.
UI_GQOS_RightRadialSkillsEnabled: Add Skills Panel to the right D-pad wheel
UI_GQOS_RightRadialSkillsEnabled_tooltip: Adds a quick-open Skills Panel action to the right D-pad wheel and transfers gamepad focus to the active skills page. Disable to remove this action.
UI_GQOS_FitnessUIEnhancementEnabled_tool:
Opens the fitness panel with the exercise you confirmed last time already selected, falling back to a default priority list when there is no record or the exercise is unavailable.
Also lets X start the workout and close the panel.
When disabled, vanilla Fitness Panel behavior is restored.
UI_GQOS_FitnessDefaultDuration_tooltip:
Duration pre-filled when the fitness panel opens.
10-60 minutes in steps of 10.
UI_GQOS_SelectWheelPvpOptionEnabled: Add extra shortcuts to the Select wheel
UI_GQOS_SelectWheelPvpOptionEnabled_tool: Disabled by default. When disabled, only the original Select-wheel entries remain. When enabled, adds the safety toggle, player panel, admin panel (admins only), PvP/War Manager panel, and the debug entry when debug mode is enabled.
UI_GQOS_ContainerPageNavMode_tooltip: In container list/details mode, hold RT before pressing D-pad Up/Down. Option 1 (default): move by 7 items each press (e.g. 1→8→15). Option 2: move to the current visible edge first, then advance by the visible page. Stops at the first/last item.
UI_GQOS_PanelInfoEnhancementEnabled_tool:
Panel enhancement, all in one switch
Info panel: press X to expand trait details, then use the D-pad to browse traits and read descriptions.
Skills panel: shows next-level XP details while selecting a skill, with RT + Up/Down paging.
Build and Handcraft panels: RT + Up/Down to page, X to favorite or unfavorite, Y to show or hide all recipes or building versions.
UI_GQOS_NutritionInfoEnabled_tooltip:
Press Y on the character info panel to expand a readout with the current fat, carbohydrate, protein and calorie values.
Vanilla only exposes these numbers in the debug menu, so this gets its own switch.
Mutually exclusive with the X trait details panel: opening one closes the other.
On by default.
UI_GQOS_splitInvLootWidth: Split-screen combined container width %% of viewport
UI_GQOS_splitInvLootWidth_tooltip: Applied separately to each player viewport in split screen. Default is 100%%; solo width settings remain independent.
UI_GQOS_splitContainerHeight_tooltip: Applied to both inventory and loot panels, relative to each player viewport.
UI_GQOS_MixedLiquidAutoDrinkEnabled_tool: When enabled, clean, non-poisonous mixtures with water as the primary fluid can be auto-drunk. Disable to restore vanilla eligibility. Use an item’s Fluid menu to opt out or back in per container.
UI_GQOS_MixedLiquidAutoDrinkDisableConta: Disable mixed-liquid auto-drink for this container
UI_GQOS_MixedLiquidAutoDrinkEnableContai: Enable mixed-liquid auto-drink for this container
UI_GQOS_DisableSmashWindowBEnabled_toolt: When enabled, temporarily removes only the native B-button binding for smashing windows at runtime; disabling this option restores the binding. It does not rewrite InputBindings XML. The Controller settings page may still show the original B binding.
UI_GQOS_sortBy_tooltip: Choose the Select/Back-button sort behavior. Options 5 and 6 are Gamepad QoL Suite extensions.
UI_GQOS_invLootWidth_tooltip: 50%% is the minimum for Steam Deck and resolutions narrower than 1600px.
UI_GQOS_invHeight_tooltip: Values above 50%% may cause UI elements clipping at lower resolutions.
UI_GQOS_lootHeight_tooltip: Values above 50%% may cause UI elements clipping at lower resolutions.
UI_GQOS_splitSection: Split-screen only (applies when two local players share the screen)
UI_GQOS_sortBy: Default sorting method with View/Back/Select button
